response.justification: Bogdan has strong general engineering leadership, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture experience, including work with multi-agent AI frameworks (MCP, agentic workflows) and real-time systems. However, his background lacks direct fintech or regulated AI system experience, and his most recent role (re:cinq) is too new to assess long-term impact. His exposure to credit systems or financial risk modeling is not evident.
strengths: Proven track record scaling engineering teams and building event-driven platforms (GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (MCP, MCP code generators) and modular architectures
Strong backend/distributed systems expertise (Dlang, Node.js, microservices, Kubernetes, real-time systems)
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulated AI systems (critical for this role)
Limited public record of leading AI-native product development in high-stakes commercial environments
Recent role at re:cinq is too new to evaluate long-term leadership impact or strategic depth
